messages:
Nora: bringing distilled-ranker-v2-int4 to staging. offline numbers look odd: NDCG down slightly, but MRR up on long queries and down on short ones. posting summary and a few suspects.

EvalBot: offline compare distilled-ranker-v2-int4 -> distilled-ranker-v2-fp32
EvalBot: NDCG@10: 0.768 -> 0.761 (-0.007)
EvalBot: MRR@10: 0.599 -> 0.612 (+0.013)  <-- aggregate up but stratified: short queries (<=5 tokens) MRR -0.045; long queries (>200 tokens) MRR +0.048

Diego: curious split. could be label alignment (train vs eval) or candidate canonicalization differences. examples?

Nora: sample short query that lost top1: "reset password" -> baseline picks doc A, ptq picks doc B. raw candidates show small casing differences and an HTML escape sequence in doc A title ("Reset & Recover Password").

Asha: HTML entities + casing can shift tokenization and similarity scores for rerankers, especially if distilled model learned to rely on literal tokens. check training label map: did we canonicalize titles/URLs?

Ben: also check how we map binary labels from graded relevance in the eval harness. small thresholding changes can flip top1. I once saw a flip when float->int cast in scoring pipeline rounded borderline scores differently under quantization.

EvalBot: quick inspect: 120 of 300 failing short-query top1 pairs contain at least one of: HTML entities (& >), unexpected casing (ALL CAPS), or inline ellipses/trailing punctuation. Tokenizer diffs present in ~72% of those.

Nora: i pushed a tiny script to canonicalize titles like training pipeline (lowercase + html_unescape + collapse_whitespace). will run a cleaned re-eval and compare.

Diego: also dump raw_hex for the candidates in the eval CSV so we can see invisible differences. our UI masks escapes so hex gives the truth.

Asha: for label mapping: confirm eval harness uses same binning thresholds as training for graded->binary. if training used threshold 1.5 and eval defaults 2.0 we will see top1 churn. add explicit label_threshold field to CSV meta.

EvalBot: re-eval with title canonicalization (lower + html_unescape) and label_threshold aligned to training (1.5):
EvalBot: NDCG@10: 0.768 -> 0.766 (-0.002)
EvalBot: MRR@10: 0.599 -> 0.605 (+0.006)
EvalBot: (short-query MRR gap shrunk from -0.045 to -0.018)

Ben: that moved the needle. residuals might be due to quant rounding on topk score ordering. let's capture score deltas for top3 per query and histogram them by query length and candidate length. small float deltas can reorder ties.

Nora: running a score-diff dump now (top3) and adding a small epsilon tie-break in the scoring comparator for the quantized path to mirror fp32 ordering. will try that on a 20k sample.

Diego: another angle: distilled model was trained with synthetic negatives sampled from BM25-windowed candidates; check if eval candidate pool ordering differs (we shuffle in eval). different candidate priors change the head distribution. add candidate_pool_seed to CSV so runs are reproducible.

Asha: good catch. we should also track sampling_strategy in CSV meta (bm25_topk vs fullpool).

EvalBot: quick run with canonicalization + tie-epsilon + fixed seed for candidate pool (seed=42):
EvalBot: NDCG@10: 0.768 -> 0.767 (-0.001)
EvalBot: MRR@10: 0.599 -> 0.607 (+0.008)
EvalBot: short-query MRR now -0.010 (much improved), long-query uplift still +0.045

Ben: long-query uplift likely from the distilled model's better head+tail attention for long contexts. that might be genuine improvement; but we need to decide whether overall tradeoff is acceptable. compute weighted MRR by our product mix (short_query_fraction=0.42).

Nora: weighted MRR delta computes to -0.002 (negligible). but product cares about short-query top1 more for search traffic; propose creating a guardrail: require short_query MRR delta >= -0.01 to promote.

Diego: agree. action items:
1) infra: add raw_hex, canonicalized_text, label_threshold, candidate_pool_seed, sampling_strategy, tie_epsilon to eval CSV/meta (Nora)
2) model: try tiny calibration step for short-query weight via sample-weighted fine-tune or a lightweight rescoring bias (Asha)
3) infra: add weighted-mix metric to dashboard and a short-query SLO; gate rollouts on that guardrail (Ben)

Nora: i'll open the infra PR and run a 50k cleaned vs raw re-eval with score diffs attached. tagging @Asha for calibration experiments.

Asha: will prototype a tiny two-epoch calibrator that increases margin for short-query positives using the failing pairs. if that closes short-query gap without hurting long-query uplift, we can ship.

QA-Bot: FYI saved sample failing pairs to s3://redwood-evals/distilled-ranker/v2/short-fail-pairs-2210001111.csv.gz

Nora: thanks everyone. syncing on Friday after the 50k run and the calibrator trial. closing loop for now. :white_check_mark:
